out.detail: upper body injury; will not play

away.summary: The Stars (9-5-1) are coming off a 6-5 win over Washington and sit third in the Central Division. They will be without defenseman Miro Heiskanen (upper body), who was injured Tuesday, along with Capobianco, Bäck, and Duchene; Sam Steel is out for personal reasons. Casey DeSmith is projected to start in net, with Jake Oettinger listed second in the projected lineup.

home.summary: The Blue Jackets (6-7-0) have several game-time decisions, per coach Rick Bowness, and Emil Andrae and Danton Heinen were loaned to Cleveland (AHL). Isac Lundestrom is injured and Erik Gudbranson is scratched. Cam Talbot is projected to start, with Jet Greaves listed as the backup.
